summary: This video reveals the 40 winners of the 350 Dragon Crystals CDK code giveaway sponsored by BuffBuff. The host uses a YouTube comment picker tool to randomly draw the winning entries live on screen. A key note shared is that promotional CDK codes issued by different creators are fully stackable on the same game account. Winners are instructed to contact the creator on Discord with proof of account ownership and subscription to claim their reward codes.
tips: CDK codes distributed by different official creators are 100% stackable and can all be redeemed on the same game account.
title: 🏆 40 GIVEAWAY WINNERS REVEALED! 🎁 350 Dragon Crystals Each! | Dragonheir: Silent Gods x BuffBuff
